levels.surface: أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: The report number «2-1» is left out. «قالا» joins the two co-transmitters into one level.
«سمعت أبي يحدث عن أبيه» is Abu Abdullah hearing his father and grandfather, both relations. Ali (أمير المؤمنين) speaks in the story, so he is the last link (rule 6).
Occurrence numbers count standalone «أبي» words, including those inside «أحمد بن أبي عبد الله» and «محمد بن أبي عمير».
